purpose: Define the Hawking/Ramanujan split before it is executed, so the split is a mechanical step rather than a design decision taken while tired at the end of a long campaign.

execution_gate.why_not: The master plan is explicit that Ramanujan I is the substrate PLUS roles, Ledger, memory, sandbox, tools, verifiers, branch economics, Adversary, Graveyard and Tribunal. A checkpoint is not automatically Ramanujan. Splitting before Math-Frozen exists would migrate contracts that bind to an artifact that does not yet exist, and the binding is the whole point of the split.

the_principle: Ramanujan owns doctrine, cognition, governance and the small trainable system. Hawking owns the substrate, the runtime, the compression foundry and the operating system. The giant artifact never moves; it is bound by immutable hash.

doctrine_and_cognition: the nine roles: Conjecturer, Skeptic, Formalizer, Prover, Computationalist, Cartographer, Librarian, Economist, Adversary, plus Director
the verification lattice: Tier 0 Asserted, Tier 1 Empirically Supported, Tier 2 Formalized, Tier 3 Proven
Tribunal and the prior-art commitment protocol
the seven memory stores: Problem, Claim, Proof-State, Counterexample, Prior-Art, Strategy, Graveyard
branch economics and the session lifecycle
the cognition mechanisms: Retina, Significance, Definitional Library, Obstruction Objects, Dual-Channel Fusion, Analogy as Partial Morphisms, Competence Cartography

the self-deception defenses: Research Object Graph, Representation/Invariant Forge, Cheapest Falsifier, Strategy Compiler, Epistemic Firewall and Diversity League, Self-Model and Calibration, Research Capsule Compiler, isolated ephemeral test-time adaptation
training_and_evaluation: the small trainable retriever, formalizer, prover, repair and value system
expert iteration, preference training, bounded verifier-guided RL, Composer-Solver curriculum, checkpoint tournaments
search_and_tools: Lean best-first / tree search, proof-state deduplication, premise retrieval, compiler-feedback repair
symbolic algebra, SAT/SMT, integer/graph/counterexample search, program synthesis, evolutionary islands

governance_ported_from_mop.note: the METHOD layer transfers, not the substrate. MOP itself is hard-protected and is not touched.

migrates_to_ramanujan.small_fixtures_only: test corpora, seeds, and small checkpoints. Nothing above a size that a git repository should hold.

stays_in_hawking: the .gravity codec, foundry and all packing machinery
the runtime, kernels, Metal, Temporal Gravity
Bridge, adapters, canonical events, CLI, SDKs
every sealed scientific receipt and negative result of the compression campaign

bound_read_only_by_hash.rule: Giant artifacts are never copied and never moved. Ramanujan binds them by immutable content address and fails loudly if the address does not resolve.

bindings.name: Math-Frozen (the Ramanujan Director)
bindings.note: This is the binding that matters. Ramanujan freezes the giant and trains the small against it. Until Math-Frozen exists, the Ramanujan repository would have no Director, which is why the split is gated rather than merely sequenced.

contracts_ramanujan_consumes_from_hawkin.note: Ramanujan needs to RUN the Director, so it needs the servable path L18 is building, not only the codec
rules and corpus are frozen and sealed; the pre-Odyssey baseline is NOT_RUN
L03 must report declared-but-absent items as DECLARED_NOT_PRESENT rather than treating a manifest entry as data
G6 requires it pinned and recorded; it is not
ROLLBACK.json declares a law, a four-step procedure and four triggers. G6 requires the path PROVEN: the substrate and its receipts must be shown to survive a failed or abandoned Odyssey.

fences_that_travel_with_the_split.RAMANUJAN_OFFLINE_MODE: true after the initial open/licensed acquisition is mirrored
fences_that_travel_with_the_split.note: The research launch fence is false at RAMANUJAN_SANDBOX_READY and stays false. Reaching the sandbox is not authorization to run research in it.

no_paid_apis_or_cloud_training: Doctrine for the whole Ramanujan half: freeze the giant, train the small, verify everything, search aggressively, escalate model size only after data, retrieval and search saturate.
controller_note: This contract is deliberately written now, while the split is far away, for the same reason ODYSSEY_PROMOTION_GATE.md was written before its decision was live: so it is not made under pressure from whatever happens to be green that day.
